usedFor: Adafruit IO logs feeds and data, and Google Drive receives file copies from “New Feed Data” through “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new reading can spawn its own named copy of a report file in a chosen folder.

watchOut: Adafruit IO triggers are polling, so “Copy a File” runs after a scheduled check, not the moment data arrives.
